name: Valerius Bactus
source: Valerius Bactus is a poisonous moth creature with chitinous traits, glowing red eyes, and toxic moth characteristics. He plays a central yandere role in the 1935 Gothic horror backdrop of Wandering Relics: Rites of the Wandering Soul.
